name: @arm/packaging
description: Signed platform installers wrapping the ARM CLI (docs/guides/03-client-downloader.md §7, A7). Not a pnpm workspace member — packaging/ sits outside the packages/*|apps/* globs on purpose (it ships build tooling, not a library other packages import). build-sea.mjs uses the root workspace's hoisted `tsup` and fetches `postject` on demand via `npx` — see README.md for the full runbook and required env vars.
